documents.title: Office Visit - Hypertension
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
HTN FOLLOW-UP (seen 3/16; labs back this morning)
Routine follow-up of severe hypertension with right renal artery FMD (dx cardiology 3/2020), with prior transient right-eye vision loss (7/2020), headaches and pulsatile tinnitus. Today she denies headache, vision changes or chest pain. Home readings have run higher this winter. Cardiology follow-up never got rebooked.
Meds: HCTZ 25 mg daily, KCl ER 20 mEq daily.

BP 180/120 (repeated after rest, similar), HR 76.
Exam normal: alert, comfortable; heart regular, no murmur; lungs clear; abdomen soft; no edema; neuro nonfocal.
Labs 3/16: creatinine and electrolytes normal — Cr 0.66, K 4.0, Na 140, HCO3 28.

A/P
1. Renovascular HTN due to right renal artery FMD — severely elevated, asymptomatic, no sign of acute end-organ injury. Add losartan 25 mg daily (unilateral disease, normal renal function). Continue HCTZ 25. Continue KCl for now; BMP in 1-2 weeks given ARB.
2. CT angiogram of the abdomen ordered to define the renal artery disease.
3. Pregnancy: losartan can harm a developing pregnancy. Counselled; she reports reliable contraception and no plans for pregnancy. Stop it and call right away if pregnancy is ever possible.
4. Will send CTA result to cardiology with another request for follow-up.
ED for severe headache, vision loss, chest pain or neuro symptoms. Recheck 6-8 weeks.

documents.title: Lab Results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Your bloodwork two weeks into losartan looks good — creatinine 0.73 (0.66 before) and potassium 4.5. Your kidneys are tolerating it. CT angiogram is booked for 4/8.

reports.study: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
reports.text:
EXAM: CT angiography of the abdomen.
INDICATION: Renovascular hypertension; known fibromuscular dysplasia of the right renal artery on ultrasound; anatomic evaluation.
TECHNIQUE: Arterial-phase helical CT of the abdomen after intravenous contrast, with multiplanar and 3D reformations.
FINDINGS:
Abdominal aorta: normal caliber.
Right renal artery: single artery with an irregular, beaded appearance and a focal area of narrowing. No aneurysm or dissection identified.
Left renal artery: single artery, normal in caliber and contour.
Kidneys: normal in size bilaterally with symmetric enhancement. No hydronephrosis.
reports.conclusion:
1. Beaded, irregular right renal artery with focal narrowing, consistent with multifocal fibromuscular dysplasia.
2. Normal left renal artery.
3. Kidneys normal in size.

documents.title: CT Angiogram Result
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Kristen, the CT angiogram confirms fibromuscular dysplasia in the artery to your right kidney — the beaded pattern typical of the multifocal type, with one narrowed area. The artery to your left kidney is normal and both kidneys are a normal size. I'm sending the report to cardiology. Keep logging your pressures; next BP visit in early June.

documents.title: Office Visit - Hypertension
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
S: BP f/u, ~3 months on losartan 25 + HCTZ 25 + KCl 20. No dizziness, cough or swelling. Home log 140s-150s/90s. No headaches lately, no vision events. Contraception unchanged.
O: BP 135/95, HR 77, wt 70.3 kg. S1 S2 normal. Clear to auscultation. No pedal edema.
A/P: Renovascular HTN (R renal FMD) — better, but diastolic and home readings still above goal. Increase losartan to 50 mg daily. BMP in 2 weeks; if potassium stays normal on the higher dose, plan to stop the KCl. Pregnancy precautions on ARB reviewed again.

medications.drug: potassium chloride 20 MEQ Extended Release Oral Tablet

documents.title: Potassium Plan
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
BMP 6/24 on losartan 50: K 4.8, Cr 0.68. Potassium has now been normal twice on losartan (4.5 in March, 4.8 now). Stop potassium chloride.
Spoke with pt; she will stop it today. Repeat BMP in about 2 weeks off potassium.

documents.title: Lab Results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Off potassium supplement ~2 weeks: K 4.2, Cr 0.75, Na 140. Low potassium has resolved on losartan. Continue losartan 50 + HCTZ 25. Pt notified via portal.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
ANNUAL PHYSICAL
38 y/o F. Feels well. Home BP since summer mostly 130s-140s over 80s. No headaches or vision changes. Off potassium since June.
Meds: losartan 50 mg daily; hydrochlorothiazide 25 mg daily. NKDA.
Contraception reliable and unchanged; understands losartan and pregnancy.
Cardiology: has not been back since 3/2020; CTA report was sent in April. She says she'll call.

Prevention: flu today. COVID primary series complete (Moderna 3/2021, 4/2021). Pap/HPV 2019 normal — next 2024. PHQ-2: 0.

Exam: BP 132/79, HR 79, T 36.5, SpO2 98%, wt 70.7 kg, BMI 25.7.
General well. Eyes/ENT normal. Thyroid not enlarged. Cardiac regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft. No edema. Skin unremarkable.

A/P
1. Renovascular HTN / R renal FMD — much improved on losartan + HCTZ. Continue. BMP today. BP visits every 6 months.
2. Health maintenance as above.
